notes.subject: עקב / יעקב
notes.rationale: go tšara ka leoto (aqav) ke papadi ya maina le Yaakobo — go a bolokwa ka go tšwa ka leoto, se se lahlegago diphetolelong tše dintši

notes.subject: ובאונו
notes.rationale: 'ka maatla a gagwe' (on = maatla, gantši gauta); KJV 'by his strength', JPS 'in his manhood' — dikgetho tše pedi tše kgolo

notes.subject: שרה את אלהים
notes.rationale: 'a lwantšha le Elohim' — šara = go lwa/khutša; ditiragatšo tše mmalwa fela; moŠepedi go se hlakang gore go lwa le mang, ka gobane tlhoko e latela ka ya morago (moloko wa Jesepo goba sengwalwa se sebotša mangeloi)

translation: Ka mpeng o ile a tšara ⟨את⟩ mokgwenyane wa gagwe ka leoto, gomme ka maatla a gagwe o ile a lwantšha le ⟨את⟩ Elohim.
